name: Python 3 & MySQL Fleet Management
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends default-mysql-server default-mysql-client
updateContentCommand: bash -c 'set -e; if [ -f packages.txt ]; then grep -v "^#" packages.txt | grep -v "^$" | xargs -r sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends; fi; if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt; fi; python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir streamlit mysql-connector-python pandas; echo "Database and Python dependencies ready"'
postStartCommand: sudo service mariadb status >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo service mysql status >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo service mariadb start || sudo service mysql start
